name.en: Shanghai Biopharmaceutical Fund (SIIC Shanghai Healthcare Capital)

aka: 上海生物医药产业股权投资基金

strategy.thesis: Municipal-government-approved biopharmaceutical investment platform initiated by state-owned SIIC Group (上实集团) at Shanghai's direction, with a RMB500bn target management scale, backing innovative drugs, high-end preparations, high-end medical devices, biotechnology and advanced pharmaceutical equipment as part of Shanghai's biopharma industry mother-fund system.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Operated by 上实资本 (SIIC Capital), which manages a family of related vehicles including 上海生物医药基金I期, 上海生物医药创新转化基金I/II期, a biopharma M&A fund, and a Hong Kong biotech fund.

summary.en: State-backed Shanghai municipal fund platform approved by the Shanghai city government and launched by SIIC Group in Dec 2020, targeting RMB500bn under management to invest in innovative drugs, high-end medical devices, biotech and advanced pharma equipment.
summary.local: 經上海市政府批准、由上實集團發起設立的市級生物醫藥投資基金平台，2020年12月成立，目標管理規模500億元人民幣，投資創新藥、高端醫療器械、生物技術及先進製藥裝備等領域。
